models.title: OpenJev
models.hardware: CUDA: one H100 in FP8 as measured. MLX siblings on Apple silicon (text only); GGUF via llama.cpp
models.notes: Launch flags are the measured ones from serve/SERVE.md. The shim has no GET /v1/models; the router answers it.

models.title: Together Tev1-4B-experimental, via Ollama
models.license: Not stated (fine-tune license being finalized); base Qwen3.5-4B is Apache-2.0
models.hardware: Whatever Ollama runs on: CPU, CUDA, or Apple silicon
models.notes: Run `ollama pull tev1` once, or set SYSTEMONE_TEV1_4B_EXPERIMENTAL_MODEL to the tag you pulled (e.g. tev1:4b-q4_K_M). Ollama builds Tev1's prompt itself; inputs should stay under ~2,000 tokens.

models.title: Together Tev1-4B-experimental, via Together chat completions (adapted)
models.license: Not stated (fine-tune license being finalized); base Qwen3.5-4B is Apache-2.0
models.stack: Together chat completions, request shape from togethercomputer/tev1 examples/decide.py
models.notes: Adapter: each question becomes 2-24 lettered options; probabilities come from top-5 letter logprobs, so with more than 5 options the rest get 0.

models.title: Cua cua-s1-4b-0.2 (adapted)
models.license: Apache-2.0 (adapter); base Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B governed by its own license
models.hardware: PyTorch mps (measured on M1 Ultra) or CPU (measured); CUDA accepted, not measured
models.notes: Adapter: trained on computer-use element/action choices, so System One questions are out of its format.

models.title: Kev-4B

models.notes: kev.serve downloads the adapter and base on first run.
